newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 27.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 27.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones rose 23.83 points to 6,546.68 PLDT's ADR slipped by $0 1/2 to $53 3/8.
* On Thursday, the peso was firmer at 26.284 to the U.S. dollar from 26.297.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,165.52, up 12.99
* The Philippine interbank call loan average rate rose to 11.625 pct from 11.21875 pct.
